style_block: Retro 1970s movie-poster anime illustration style, in the vein of vintage Japanese poster art. Bold, clean, confident ink outlines with rich cel-shaded coloring, semi-realistic anime-influenced facial proportions with expressive detailed eyes and sharp confident brows, warm dusty amber and burnt-orange sunset color grading, soft painterly gradients in skies and backgrounds, strong graphic silhouettes, dramatic three-quarter poses, textured painterly matte backgrounds with light film grain, high-contrast rim lighting separating the subject from the background. Palette runs warm gold, amber and burnt orange during scenes of success, cools toward desaturated dusty blue-grey during scenes of collapse and loss, and returns to a warm faded sepia-gold in the final scenes. Cinematic 16:9 composition, bold and readable at small size. No photorealism, no 3D render, no live-action photography, no watermark, no signature, no extra fingers, no distorted limbs, no garbled or misspelled lettering, no readable numbers or markings of any kind, no text anywhere in the image.

Style block and PEAK_BURT descriptor rewritten to match that reference (aviators pushed up on messy hair, open denim shirt, gold chain).
